messages:
mara (sec-eng): FYI CI just started failing a bunch of PRs with the new static analyzer rule for YAML parsers. Looks noisy; I dug into a sample and it's flagging a harmless vendor comment as "unused-flag". Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/45532
scan-bot: sast-check / py-sast v3.2.1 - failure on commit 8f7a2d3 - rule: RB-UNUSED-FLAG - 12 hits
samir (eng): I saw that earlier on my branch. It's triggered by a generated fixture file we vendored. Repro: run `tools/sast/run --path=vendor/lig-example`
priya (sre): What's our blocking policy here? Is this considered a pre-merge blocker automatically?
mara (sec-eng): Current policy marks high or critical as PR-blocking. This is medium/low noise but it's spammy. Options: 1) add suppression for that file path 2) tune rule to ignore vendor patterns 3) upstream fix in the vendor (unlikely)
jonathan (infra): If we just suppress in repo we need an audit trail and expiry window. Don't want permanent silences.
lisa (product): From product side, we care about developer velocity. If this is blocking feature work, temporary suppression + follow-up is fine.
mara (sec-eng): Proposed immediate plan: - add repo-level suppression scoped to `vendor/lig-example/**` with an expiration in 30 days - create a ticket to either: improve rule to check comments or remove vendor file - audit: log suppression PR and attach evidence
samir (eng): I can open PR for suppression today. What should the suppression metadata include?
mara (sec-eng): Include: who approved (security lead), why (false positive due to generated comment), evidence (scan output + reproduction steps), expiry date, and ISSUE-# link. Example suppression entry we use in .sastignore: ```yaml # .sastignore
- path: vendor/lig-example/**
  rule: RB-UNUSED-FLAG
  reason: "vendor generated fixture contains trailing comment that triggers rule; false positive"
  approved_by: "mara"
  expires_on: "2024-04-05"
```
scan-bot: suppression suggested: add entry to .sastignore to silence 12 occurrences. Use `/suppress add` to generate PR.
samir (eng): /suppress add --path vendor/lig-example --rule RB-UNUSED-FLAG --expires 2024-04-05 -> opened branch `suppress/vendor-lig-example-rb-unused-flag`
jonathan (infra): Make sure CI audit logs capture who merged the suppression PR and store the diff in KMS-backed artifact storage. We need tamper-evidence for audits.
mara (sec-eng): Agreed. Add requirement to the PR template for suppression: add `security/audit: true` and upload reproducer logs to `s3://redwood-sec-audit/suppressions/2024-03-06/`. Those buckets are KMS-encrypted and IAM-restricted.
priya (sre): I'll add a short runbook snippet for oncall if similar noise spikes again: escalate to sec-eng if >10 suppression-worthy hits across >3 repos in a 24h window.
lisa (product): Timeline check: will suppression PR block anything?
samir (eng): PR is non-blocking, test-only changes to .sastignore. I'll mark as security-sensitive and request mara review.
mara (sec-eng): After merge, I'll add a Jira task `SEC-4312` to re-evaluate rule parsing and assign to eng-ml for rule tuning. If they can't deliver in 30 days, we either extend expiry or propose a global rule change with release notes.
jonathan (infra): Small ops note: ensure CloudTrail entries are present for the KMS decrypt used when retrieving the reproducer. Attach KMS key alias `alias/sec-audit` in the ticket.
samir (eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7823 - added .sastignore entry, audit artifacts uploaded to S3 as specified.
mara (sec-eng): Reviewing now. Quick checklist I use: reproduce locally, check suppression scope (no over-broad globs), audit artifact present, approver signed, expiry date set.
scan-bot: PR 7823 merged by samir at 1709004000 - suppression entry active.
priya (sre): After merge, CI noise drops from 12 -> 0 for this rule on that repo. Logging: https://observability.redwood/alerts/scan-noise-1709004
lisa (product): Great outcome. Please keep product updated via the jira ticket on longer-term rule changes.
mara (sec-eng): Filed SEC-4312 with acceptance criteria: (1) new rule heuristics to ignore trailing vendor comments (2) unit tests showing no regressions (3) rollout plan and monitoring. Assigning to @eng-ml.
jonathan (infra): One last compliance note: for our annual audit we need a CSV export of suppressions with metadata (path, rule, approver, expiry, PR link). Can we add export hook to the audit bucket?
mara (sec-eng): I'll add that to SEC-4312 as an action item. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
